name: Low-Carb Turkey Enchilada Casserole
ingredients_verbatim: 1 onion, chopped in pieces about 1/2 inch or slightly smaller
1 large Poblano (Pasilla) pepper, chopped in pieces about 1/2 inch or slightly smaller
2 lbs. ground turkey (or use ground beef if you prefer)
salt and fresh ground black pepper to season turkey
2 cans (15 oz.) red chile enchilada sauce
3/4 cup sour cream (plus more for serving if desired, optional)
1 large can (27 oz.) whole green chiles
1/2 cup grated Four Cheese Mexican Blend
why: In-band verified: 538 cal / 10.7 g carb / 43 g protein per serving on the source page. True low-carb dinner - no tortillas, rice, or beans; layered whole green chiles stand in for the tortillas, so structurally meat+cheese+peppers. Ground turkey, straight oven bake at 375 (30-35 min), no skillet finish. Scales cleanly to 14 by weight. Every signature ingredient already has a board home. Not a duplicate of turkey-taco-casserole or the nacho bake (enchilada-sauce + green-chile layering, cheese-set casserole).
